---
name: Ask for a cited-result entry
about: Request what the project recorded about an external result it relies on
labels: cited-result
---

**Which result.** The author, year and theorem or equation number, as this project
cites it. If you have a claim page under `docs/results/` in front of you, its
identifier helps.

**What you need.** Usually one of:

- the exact locator this project used, and its verdict on whether the hypotheses
  are satisfied, which can be answered in this issue;
- the transcribed passage and the surrounding discussion, which lives in the
  cited-result compendia held privately (see THIRD-PARTY.md).

**Note.** For most purposes the original paper is the better source, and
`refs/REFERENCES.md` lists every one with the exact result used;
`refs/restore.sh` fetches the openly available ones.
